assertions.subject: Necrolytic acral erythema
assertions.quote: Necrolytic acral erythema can be misdiagnosed as several other dermatological conditions

assertions.subject: Necrolytic acral erythema
assertions.quote: Necrolytic acral erythema can be differentiated from psoriasis by its dark and verrucous scales

assertions.subject: Necrolytic acral erythema
assertions.quote: Necrolytic acral erythema can be differentiated from psoriasis by its dark and verrucous scales and the absence of central clearing

assertions.subject: Psoriasis
assertions.quote: Psoriasis often presents with well-demarcated, erythematous plaques

assertions.subject: Psoriasis
assertions.quote: Psoriasis often presents with well-demarcated, erythematous plaques covered with silvery scales

assertions.subject: Necrolytic acral erythema
assertions.quote: Unlike necrolytic acral erythema, lichen simplex chronicus lacks necrotic features

assertions.subject: Lichen simplex chronicus
assertions.quote: Lichen simplex chronicus is another skin disorder characterized by thickened, scaly patches

assertions.subject: Erythrokeratoderma
assertions.quote: Erythrokeratoderma manifests as hyperkeratotic, erythematous plaques

assertions.subject: Nummular eczema
assertions.quote: Nummular eczema is characterized by coin-shaped, erythematous, and scaly plaques

assertions.subject: Dermatophytosis
assertions.predicate: erythematous plaques with central clearing and peripheral scaling
assertions.quote: Dermatophytosis presents with erythematous plaques with central clearing and peripheral scaling

assertions.subject: Necrolytic acral erythema
assertions.quote: The absence of central clearing and the distinct histopathological features of necrolytic acral erythema assist in distinguishing it from dermatophytosis
